caption: Figure 5: A illustration of networking in MAAS with NVLink (a) and without it. Note that the 256 Gbps PCIe is shared between two GPUs attached to it [48].
subject: how GPU-to-GPU bandwidth differs between an NVSwitch/NVLink fabric and a shared PCIe link when no NVLink is present

groups.why_chosen: NVLink connects all of a server's GPUs through an NVSwitch at 1.6 Tbps per GPU, far faster than the 200 Gbps inter-server RDMA network; without NVLink, GPU pairs instead share just a 256 Gbps PCIe link.
groups.what_to_learn: two identical Server0/RDMA/Server1/NIC templates side by side, differing only in how the bottom row of GPUs is interconnected
